pack.title: Receiving fake apology
pack.description: Ask for acknowledgment of what happened.

scenarios.setting: A friend apologizes by blaming you for being upset.
scenarios.jab: I'm sorry you took it that way.
scenarios.goal: Ask for acknowledgment of what happened.

replies.line: I'd like us to talk about the comment, rather than my reaction.
replies.why: It redirects the discussion to the behavior that needs repair.
replies.delivery: Keep your voice soft and specific; quote the comment once instead of listing past conflicts.

replies.why: It asks for accountability without evaluating the whole friendship.
replies.delivery: Keep your voice soft and specific; quote the comment once instead of listing past conflicts.

replies.line: I want to move forward; it would help if you acknowledged what the comment did.
replies.why: It connects repair to a specific acknowledgment rather than a perfect apology.
replies.delivery: Keep your voice soft and specific; quote the comment once instead of listing past conflicts.

replies.line: Can we put the comment in the spotlight for a minute?
replies.why: A mild metaphor redirects attention without mocking the apology.
replies.delivery: Keep your voice soft and specific; quote the comment once instead of listing past conflicts.

followUp.line: I heard that; I'm asking you to understand why the comment hurt.
followUp.why: It recognizes the apology while naming the unfinished part of the repair.
followUp.delivery: Keep your voice soft and specific; quote the comment once instead of listing past conflicts.
